root_cause.text: The `sev_ioctl_do_pek_csr` function in `drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev.c` fails to check the return status of the PSP firmware command (`__sev_do_cmd_locked`) before copying the CSR blob to userspace, which causes an out-of-bounds read from the kernel-allocated buffer when the command fails due to an insufficient buffer length.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (ret || WARN_ON_ONCE(argp->error)) goto e_free_blob;` immediately after updating `input.length` and copying it to userspace, but before executing `copy_to_user(input_address, blob, input.length)`. This prevents copying the blob when the firmware command fails.

The group's core intent is to add a guard check to prevent copying data to user space if the SEV command execution failed, which directly addresses the vulnerability's root cause of failing to check the return status of the PSP firmware command before copying data to userspace.

candidates.rationale: This statement only checks if the 'blob' buffer is allocated, but fails to check if the preceding SEV command execution succeeded (i.e., ret == 0) before proceeding to copy the buffer to userspace.
This statement copies the buffer to userspace without ensuring that the SEV command succeeded, potentially leading to an out-of-bounds read of the kernel-allocated buffer if the command failed.
